title: Datasheet for accepted dataset #2 (DepMap public release)
context: Second end-to-end datasheet, for a DepMap public release file. Binding cancer guardrails apply: open-access / aggregate / de-identified data only; controlled-access (dbGaP, EGA, ICGC DACO, individual-level biobanks) and any identifiable patient data are OUT OF SCOPE; COSMIC/OncoKB are non-commercial/custom (flag, never treat as open); no medical advice; provenance on every assertion. Depends on the pilot pipeline and the triage results; DepMap license is verified per-release.
objective: Produce a complete, gate-passed, provenance-backed datasheet for a DepMap public-release dataset and get it accepted (or submitted with the blocker surfaced).
acceptanceCriteria: Dataset is a DepMap public release confirmed open-access with its per-release license verified (permitsDerivatives: true, cited clause); passed gate-004 with the artifact committed.
Complete data dictionary, access-tier + identifiability assessment, Datasheet, and valid Croissant produced; every assertion carries a provenance citation; completeness >= 90/100.
Provenance + license snapshot recorded (committed copy + SHA-256 + Wayback URL), including the required DepMap citation and release/freeze.
Documentation accepted via the DepMap maintainer/forum channel with the acceptance artifact (outcomes/<dataset-id>.json) recorded -- or submitted with the blocker surfaced.
